title: Zephyrine and the Escarpment
author: Odile Ishikawa
blurb: Coral Voss, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
